comfort.kort: For travellers who above all want a good night's sleep. In the morning you set off again well rested.
comfort.desc: Enjoy a comfortable, modern room, ideal for a relaxing stay in North Limburg. Whether you are here for a short break or a business visit, you will feel at home straight away in our Comfort room.
tekst: Enjoy a comfortable, modern room, ideal for a relaxing stay in North Limburg. Whether you are here for a short break or a business visit, you will feel at home straight away in our Comfort room.
The room has two single beds, a private bathroom with shower and a seating area with comfortable chairs: everything you need to unwind.

comfort-3.kort: Travelling as a three? Then you can end the evening together in one room.
comfort-3.desc: Our Comfort room for 3 offers extra space for families or friends travelling together. Everything is there for a pleasant, carefree stay in green North Limburg.
tekst: Our Comfort room for 3 offers extra space for families or friends travelling together. Everything is there for a pleasant, carefree stay in green North Limburg.
Three single beds, a private bathroom and a cosy seating area make this room ideal for travelling together.
kenmerken: Private bathroom with shower and/or bath

mindervalide.kort: Designed for guests in a wheelchair, with extra-wide doors and an adapted bathroom.
mindervalide.desc: Our adapted room is specially designed for guests with limited mobility. Our restaurant and terrace are wheelchair-friendly too, so during your stay you can enjoy a lovely dinner and the hospitality of Asteria without a care.
tekst: Our adapted room is specially designed for guests with limited mobility. Our restaurant and terrace are wheelchair-friendly too, so during your stay you can enjoy a lovely dinner and the hospitality of Asteria without a care.
A spacious layout, extra-wide doors and an adapted bathroom provide comfort and independence.
kenmerken: Sofa bed for extra sleeping space
Extra-wide doors and a spacious layout for a wheelchair or rollator
Spacious seating area with comfortable chairs

royale.kort: A weekend away, with time to unpack your suitcase and simply be there for a while.
royale.desc: Our Royale rooms are larger than the Comfort rooms and offer that little bit extra. The sense of space and the comfortable seating area make this room ideal if you want a touch more luxury during your stay.
tekst: Our Royale rooms are larger than the Comfort rooms and offer that little bit extra. The sense of space and the comfortable seating area make this room ideal if you want a touch more luxury during your stay.
Choose a double bed or twin beds and enjoy the extra space and a private bathroom with shower or bath.
kenmerken: Double bed or twin beds (2 single beds)
Spacious seating area with comfortable chairs
Private bathroom with shower and/or bath

deluxe.kort: After a day outdoors you slip into your own sauna and the tiredness slowly melts away.
deluxe.desc: Our Deluxe rooms have everything for a luxurious stay in North Limburg. The private infrared sauna in the bathroom makes this room ideal if you really want to relax: a small wellness experience in your own room.
tekst: Our Deluxe rooms have everything for a luxurious stay in North Limburg. The private infrared sauna in the bathroom makes this room ideal if you really want to relax: a small wellness experience in your own room.
Besides your own sauna, you enjoy a comfortable seating area with every convenience within reach.
kenmerken: Double bed or twin beds (2 single beds)

suite.kort: To celebrate an anniversary or birthday, with a night you will still be talking about later.
suite.desc: Experience Asteria in our most spacious and luxurious room. With a private infrared sauna, a spacious seating area and every convenience within reach, the Suite is the place to unwind completely: more than a hotel room, a complete experience.
tekst: Experience Asteria in our most spacious and luxurious room. With a private infrared sauna, a spacious seating area and every convenience within reach, the Suite is the place to unwind completely: more than a hotel room, a complete experience.
A king-size bed and a sofa bed sleep up to four people.
kenmerken: Sofa bed for extra sleeping space
Spacious seating area with comfortable chairs

bruidssuite.kort: After the big day, or simply an evening for the two of you: run the bath and unwind.
bruidssuite.desc: Our Bridal suite is designed for special moments. Whether you have just got married or are celebrating a romantic weekend, enjoy the luxury, the peace and the warm atmosphere that make Asteria what it is.
tekst: Our Bridal suite is designed for special moments. Whether you have just got married or are celebrating a romantic weekend, enjoy the luxury, the peace and the warm atmosphere that make Asteria what it is.
A freestanding bath, a spacious walk-in shower and bathrobes with slippers complete your stay.
kenmerken: Spacious seating area with comfortable chairs
